# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Base capability provenance (sibling run, same seed)
- What worked (confirmed by the sibling RESULT, reused_seed_run cand_0001 accepted 0.45→0.95): grading CONTRACT (values not formulas even when "formula" is asked; typed values; preserve originals), inspect→write→reopen→verify→stop workflow, conditional semantic rules in prompt §2.
- What didn't (sibling rejected cand_0002–0005): mandatory ANSWER TYPE step; pruning; openpyxl as default writer; bundled max_row append filter + tie-break paragraph.
- Promising but not yet tried in isolation: one-sentence date-component→int CONTRACT narrowing (shipped in this cand_0001; awaiting RESULT); 80-42 append-position rule alone.

## 43436 column-letter mapping
- What worked (cand_0002 RESULT fixed={43436}): when the agent prints headers keyed by cell coordinate, it maps H/I/J/K correctly and passes. The semantics (§2 snapshot rule) were already right.
- What didn't (cand_0002 RESULT broke={267-18, 37456}): a GLOBAL Phase-1 recipe rewrite (co-occurred with the 37456 break), and a Phase-3 item that read a `None` target as "shifted letters" only. In 267-18 the `None` came from a formula that lost its cached value, and the agent stopped writing its literal.
- Promising (cand_0003, awaiting RESULT): the same mechanism as a CONDITIONAL §3 bullet, plus a two-cause Phase-3 item that tells the causes apart by `was:`.
